item.description:
FANcy 1.3.0

  • Automatic updates. FANcy now checks for new versions once a day and offers them right in the app — every download is signed and verified, and nothing installs without your click. You can also check any time with Check for Updates… in the menu bar.
  • Tested. The fan-curve math and the built-in profiles are now covered by automated tests that run on every change.

Coming from 1.2.0 or earlier? Install this version once from the DMG — from then on, updates find you.
